// diagnostic

E2819

`{method}` is marked `#{marker}`, which keeps it on the server, and `#{endpoint}`, which makes it an endpoint.

What

`{method}` is marked `#{marker}`, which keeps it on the server, and `#{endpoint}`, which makes it an endpoint.

Why

A job runs after the call that queued it commits, as the system; a schedule runs on its clock, as the system; a webhook runs for a sender that signs its deliveries; a signing key gives the key that checks them. Only the server runs each, so no client may call one through `app.Remote`.

Fix

Remove `#{endpoint}` from `{method}`, and give clients an endpoint method of their own; it can queue a job with `app.enqueue`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2819: tests/ui/web_app_job_marked_endpoint.stderr.

Error [jet.ServerOnlyMethodMarkedEndpoint]: `send` is marked `#App.Job`, which keeps it on the server, and `#App.SignedIn`, which makes it an endpoint.

 Fix: Remove `#App.SignedIn` from `send`, and give clients an endpoint method of their own; it can queue a job with `app.enqueue`.
